title: 2.8 Basic Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear and say six colors, ask What color is it? / What color are they?, and describe a known thing with its color.
grammar_function: What color is it? / What color are they?; It is + color; They are + color; a + color + noun.
prerequisite: 1.3 they are; 2.1 it is; 2.2-2.3 bus, bike, car, chair, bag, table; 2.4 What is it?; 2.6-2.7 counting photos.
speaking_outcome: Answer What color is it? and name a known thing with its color.
